fightOffers.pitch: A fair fight on paper. The kind careers are made of.

fighter.statement: I’d rather get stopped swinging than win a round running. I don’t take a backward step. Never have.
fighter.ceilingRead: Handled right, he could surprise some people down the line.

fighter.statement: I don’t need you to believe in me. I need you to train me. Everybody around here already counted me out. That’s fine by me. I’ve been overlooked my whole life. I’m used to it. It just makes me work.
fighter.ceilingRead: He’s got more in him than most who come through that door.

fighter.statement: Where I’m from, you either fight or you disappear. I’d rather fight. I’ve seen what happens to men who stay where I’m from. I’m getting out.
fighter.ceilingRead: There’s a useful fighter in here — nothing flashy, but useful.

history.text: You signed the lease and put the name on the door: The Kitchen.

recentLog.text: The door is open. The bags are hung. Now you wait and see who walks in.
